name: Workspace Grid
author: robi
description: 2D grid workspace switcher for the bar that replaces the linear Omarchy workspaces widget. Shows the most recently focused app icon on each workspace. Enable and the grid takes over the built-in workspace slot; disable and omarchy.workspaces returns automatically.

barWidget.description: 2D grid workspace switcher with app icons, gestures and keys

schema.label: Grid columns
schema.description: Number of workspace columns (workspaces fill left to right, row by row).

schema.label: Cell size (px)
schema.description: Width of each workspace cell in the bar.

schema.label: Clamp at grid edges
schema.description: Stop at the grid edge instead of wrapping to the opposite side.

schema.label: Show app icons
schema.description: Show the most recently focused app's icon on each occupied workspace.

schema.label: Always show numbers
schema.description: Keep the workspace number visible even when an app icon is shown.
